# Quantum Growth

> Websites, Google Business Profile management and local search for small local
> businesses. Nationwide, month to month, and the client owns everything.

Phone: (916) 868-2447
Site: https://replace-with-your-domain.com/

## What it is
A one-person agency that builds the website, runs the Google Business Profile
and reports the calls it produced using Google's own numbers. The domain, the
site, the Google listing and the phone number are registered in the client's
name from day one, so nothing is switched off if they leave.

## Plans
- **Starter** — $699 build one time, then $79/month, or $711/year. A 25-page
  website on the client's own domain, business email, social profiles, hosting,
  SSL, backups and unlimited text edits.
- **Local** — $299/month or $2,691/year, build included free. Everything in
  Starter plus Google Business Profile management, 8 social posts a month,
  citations across 40+ directories, review generation, and a monthly report
  built from Google's own data.
- **Growth** — $599/month or $5,391/year, build included free. Everything in
  Local plus 16 social posts a month, local authority links, two new pages a
  month, and follow-up campaigns for quotes and enquiries that went quiet.
- **Market Leader** — $999/month or $8,991/year, build included free.
  Everything in Growth plus 24 posts a month with video, every town the client
  serves written up individually on the service-area page, managed Google Ads or
  Local Services Ads, and missed-call text-back.
- **Basic Site** — $599 one time, or $400 same day, then $29/month hosting. A
  website with no marketing plan attached.
- **Add to any plan** — quoted before work starts: PPC and Meta ad management; lead
  generation and CRM setup (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, industry-specific CRMs);
  AI-assisted promotional content, video and localized ad copy; social media management.

## Apps
Built as installable web apps by default: they install to the home screen from a
link, so there are no store fees and nothing for a customer to download.
- **Starter App** — $699.99 build, then $49/month. Booking, ordering and quote
  requests on the client's own domain, works offline.
- **Business App** — $999 build, then $99/month. Adds photo updates sent to the
  customer, customer accounts with history, and automatic follow-up.
- **Custom Build** — from $1,499.99, monthly quoted with the build. Portals,
  bookings, stock and integrations. Begins with a $499 scoping session that
  produces a written spec the client owns, credited against the build.
- **App Store and Google Play listing** — optional add-on, $499 one time then
  $25/month, submitted under developer accounts in the client's own business name,
  so the listings belong to the client. Apple's $99/year and Google's one-time $25
  are paid at cost. A first listing takes two to four weeks. Apple rejects anything
  it reads as a repackaged website, so native pieces are built in first; if it still
  cannot be cleared, $250 is refunded.

Quantum Growth's stated position is that most small local businesses do not need
an app, and it says so rather than selling one.

## Terms
Paid monthly: no contract, no notice period, cancel any month. Paying for a year
up front gives three months free (monthly price x 9). The year is paid in advance
and is not refunded if the client leaves early; the site stays live until it runs out.
The client keeps the domain, the Google profile, the email and the website
files, delivered as a zip. Hosting is part of the monthly, so it stops on
cancelling — the files can stay hosted for $29/month or move to the client's own
hosting.

On Starter there is never a cancellation fee, because the build was paid up
front. On the plans where the build was free, the unearned part of that $699
becomes payable: $600 if the client leaves in months one or two, $400 in months
three or four, $200 in months five or six, and nothing after six months.

## Consulting
- **Visibility Audit** — $499 one time. A written teardown of map-pack position,
  profile gaps and what the site is missing.
- **Strategy and advisory** — $175/hour, no retainer or minimum.
